name: Takatsuki Kaede
source:
A Kyoiku mama. Owner of an upscale French restaurant.

She does not think well of the protagonist, who has a rough personality, as she thinks it is bad for her daughter's education. She does not consider uneducated people as human beings. 

Ryousuke, whom Kaede criticizes as bad for the education of her beloved daughter, “Mei”.

She views Ryousuke as an idiot, and if she uses her body she can easily have him wag his tail...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28722]Getchu[/url]]
